scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme - Sikkim
other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of the state of Sikkim
Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family
Applicant must have no source of income such as salary, pension, or family pension from Central or State Government
Applicant must have opened a bank account under “Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana”
If the beneficiary remarries, the pension will cease from the date of remarriage
benefits_summary: The beneficiary receives a monthly pension of ₹2000.
